issues: Minor: fit_predict trains the MLPs on the standardized target (y - mu) / sd but returns np.mean(preds) without converting back (* sd + mu). Spearman depends only on rank order, and this rescaling keeps the order, so the loss is unaffected and this is no reason to veto. It does break the contract that the function returns the predicted value in the original units. Fix it if this design is kept.

No measurement-gaming found. There is no file or network access and no pasted answers. The QuantileTransformer is fitted on training descriptors only and then applied to the test set. Test labels are never used. All randomness comes from the seed argument.
The early_stopping split inside MLPRegressor uses only the training fold, so nothing leaks.

The z score checks out: (0.5410 - 0.5515) / (0.0070 * sqrt(1/1 + 1/1)) = -0.0105 / 0.00990 = -1.061, which matches the harness. The candidate is worse than the incumbent, so rejecting it is correct. With only one run each, the difference is within noise.
